set.body:
Add a cross-platform surface-view-raster reference interpreter that consumes SurfaceRenderPlan and emits graphics.RasterImage plus exact render and pick receipts. Implement deterministic homogeneous clipping, depth buffering, triangle winding/culling, barycentric interpolation, base plus overlay compositing, unlit scientific color, and one simple documented Lambert mode. This is a correctness oracle and headless fallback, not the primary interactive backend.

Build asymmetric fixtures with known left/right/anterior/posterior/superior/inferior landmarks, nontrivial surfaceToWorld transforms, reversed winding cases, sparse fields, scalar threshold boundaries, categorical labels, overlapping layers, and known screen-to-face-to-vertex picks. Add tolerant image comparison utilities that mask antialiasing edges separately from semantic pixels.

Acceptance: byte-stable JVM/Scala.js unlit images; exact depth, threshold, blend-order, missing-value, orientation, and pick results; no allocation per pixel in hot loops; reference receipts expose triangles, clipped triangles, shaded pixels, cache work, and elapsed compilation/render phases; surfaceViewRasterJVM/test and surfaceViewRasterJS/test pass.
set.title: Surface reference renderer: deterministic raster oracle and orientation fixtures
